decision_rationale: The paper presents X-Cell as a diffusion language model that reconstructs perturbed gene-expression profiles from control cells. It is trained on a very large compendium and claims zero-shot prediction across cellular contexts, which supports foundation-model-like breadth.
evidence_snippet: "X-Cell is a set-level diffusion transformer that predicts perturbed gene expression profiles from control cell populations"; "trained explicitly on interventional data"; "zero-shot prediction"; "generalizable cellular foundation models"; "> 10 million cells" and "> 20 million cells" from X-Atlas/Pisces
